reason: It is free for me, and a written contract with stage sign-offs is exactly what I lacked last time, but I have no idea who checks these crews or what happens if one walks off mid-job, and those are the two things that cost me before. I would not hand my flat to an offer that leaves both blank.
objection: Will the crew in Tbilisi actually bid on a standard brief? And who vouches for them when the verification process is still undefined?
would_change_my_mind: A named verification process I can read, a clear written plan for when a crew stops mid-job, and proof that real crews have bid on a brief and finished work.
